name: Chigara Ashada
source:
The Captain of the Science Club. There is just one minor problem with this: she thinks it is a baking club.

All she wanted was to join the baking club. Unfortunately, a group of seniors kidnapped her during her second year and made her join the science club instead. They even let her use the matter replicator to make pastries as long as she did some research for them from time to time.

Now, a year has passed and all the seniors have graduated, leaving Chigara as the only member of the science club. And if she doesn't find four more members by the end of the week, her club will be disbanded!

Can [url=/c22166]Kayto[/url] save the science club? Or is this going to end in a big bang?
translation:
科学部部长。唯一的小问题是：她以为自己加入的是烘焙部。

她只是想加入烘焙部，却在二年级时被一群前辈绑走，强行加入科学部。前辈们甚至允许她使用物质复制机制作糕点，只要她偶尔为他们做些研究。

一年过去，所有前辈都毕业了，科学部只剩下她一个人。如果她不能在本周结束前找到另外四名成员，社团就会被解散！

[url=/c22166]凯托[/url]能拯救科学部吗？还是一切会以大爆炸告终？
